entries.b3ddb388e35c4071: This business, centered on Kirin Brewery Company, Limited and LION PTY LTD, manufactures and sells beer and low-alcohol beverages in Japan and overseas; it is the largest segment by revenue in the Kirin Group. In Japan, Kirin Brewery Company, Limited manufactures and sells beer-type beverages and low-alcohol beverages, among others. Overseas, LION PTY LTD, as the regional management company, mainly manufactures and sells beer and low-alcohol beverages in Oceania, and craft beer in North America. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,075,261 million, down 0.6% year on year. In Japan, the Ichiban Shibori brand performed steadily, and a review of the brand mix and price revisions supported revenue. LION PTY LTD's sales volume exceeded the previous year, and its revenue on a local currency basis was roughly the same as the previous year. Until September 2025, LION PTY LTD oversaw Australia, New Zealand and North America; from October, its structure changed so that it focuses on Oceania. Kirin Brewery Company, Limited, a major subsidiary accounting for more than 10% of consolidated revenue, had revenue of ¥665,500 million (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies).
